Import required library 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
```

Global file path 
```{r}
dataset_path <- "/Users/sorenbasnet/Documents/Github/STAT_443_FINAL_PROJECT/data/prediction_death_5_years"
dataset_filename <- "data_patient_file_cna_rai.txt"
```

#Datasets

This requires a file that has a one hot coded column - surv5yrs 

surv5yrs := 1{ patient died within 5 years of diagnosis }

```{r}
data_patient_clinical <- read.table(file.path(dataset_path, dataset_filename), header=TRUE, sep=" ")
```

Colnames
```{r}
colnames(data_patient_clinical)
```

We need to subset a little but of columns 

```{r}
data_patient_clinical <- data_patient_clinical %>% select(-c(ONCOTREE_CODE, DISEASE_TYPE, SOMATIC_STATUS,CLL_EPITYPE,TUMOR_MOLECULAR_SUBTYPE,SEQUENCING_PLATFORM,RNA_SEQUENCING,RRBS,ARRAY450K, M.CLL_WES,U.CLL_WES,EC_DISCOVERY,EC_EXTENSION,IGLV3_21_R110,COHORT,CANCER_TYPE,CANCER_TYPE_DETAILED,TREATMENT_STATUS,PRIOR_TREATMENT_CATEGORY,SAMPLE_ID))

data_patient_clinical <- data_patient_clinical %>% select(-c(OS_STATUS,OS_MONTHS,DEATH_DAYS))

head(data_patient_clinical)
```

Logistic regression 
```{r}

m1 <- glm(death_5yr ~ ., data=data_patient_clinical, family="binomial")
summary(m1)

```
